QuestInfo.name: Asking After Bruce, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with his work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to check on a man named #b#p206##k, a resident of the town. Let's go see how #p206# is doing.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p206#, a resident of #m10001000#. I'm glad to see he's doing well!

0.0: "I'm curious to know how #p206#, one of #m10001000#'s residents, is doing lately. It would be wonderful if you could check on him for me.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: Ah, you must be #h0#. Where are you planning to head off for an adventure today? The Ant Tunnel? The Golem Temple? Wherever it is, I'm sure it'll be absolutely wonderful. Just think of all the new monsters you'll get to see.
1.1: As a biologist who researches animals and monsters, I'd love to go on an adventure myself, but it's far too dangerous a task, you see. If you happen to encounter any unusual monsters during your travels, please do come and tell me all about them.

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, I must say.
